verdict.rationale: Community Phone documents one user-configurable background automation: you can 'set up automated calls to check on them or remind them' for a loved one's line (docs-15). It also offers rule-based call routing and forwarding that run unattended (docs-16, docs-18), but these are narrow telephony features, not general-purpose autonomous automations. missing for 10: general automation or workflow builder, AI/agent-driven autonomous tasks, API or programmatic triggers (OpenAPI probe 404), detailed docs on configuring and scheduling the automated calls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
